newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-KUKOC SAYS BULLS' TRIANGLE OFFENSE IS JUST FINE, THANK YOU.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-KUKOC SAYS BULLS' TRIANGLE OFFENSE IS JUST FINE, THANK YOU.

text.p: The Chicago Bulls' scoring has not been up to their championship level in these playoffs but when it was suggested their trademark triangle offence wasn't working as well as in the past, Toni Kukoc begged to differ.

"How do you know that?" the Croatian swingman challenged the reporter who made the suggestion at practice Tuesday. "It doesn't look good? It works great. We're in the Finals and we're one game up (over the Utah Jazz) and it works.
"I don't really know how much you know about the triangle, but it works pretty good. Everything we're trying to accomplish is there."

Kukoc, a former winner of the NBA's Sixth Man award, has estimated he was playing only at about 90 percent physical efficiency because of a foot injury. Asked again how the foot was Tuesday, he said: "Usual." Did that mean it was neither better nor worse? "Yeah, it's pretty much the same."
Kukoc, who is shooting below his usual standards, was asked what he needs to get untracked. "Hit 10 shots in a row would be good," he said.
